scope.originalBundledCatalogue: 42 places and 16 guides remain separate and unchanged by the directory expansion.
scope.reviewType: Targeted age/privacy delta audit of native metadata, resolved owned articles and browser launch flow. Not a new review of all factual claims in all linked pages.

recommendedQuestionnaireChanges.basis: Expanded curated directory links a yoga article that recommends self-directed practice and wellness articles covering self-care activities. This goes beyond the original bundled amenity descriptions.

The linked altitude page gives general illness symptoms and stop-ascent, descent and emergency-response guidance. Apple includes condition-management guidance, not only diagnosis. These are ancillary safety topics within a broad travel directory; the app is not focused on medical treatment.

The native directory presents 667 commission-bearing provider links with booking calls to action and adjacent affiliate disclosures. Treat this as paid/native product promotion for the age capability answer. An advertising SDK is not required by this definition.
recommendedQuestionnaireChanges.confidence: reasoned application of Apple paid/native-promotion definition to commission-bearing recommendations

recommendedRetainedAnswers.basis: The broad travel catalogue includes craft-beer/distillery/apres-ski references; inspected native metadata has no intense intoxication presentation. Existing mild answer remains supported. This targeted audit does not certify every future remotely edited article.

The native app offers curated, validated destination CTAs, local catalogue search, and no arbitrary URL entry or general web search. System-browser address display is read-only on iOS. This is a behaviour-based questionnaire interpretation, not a claim that the initial URL allowlist constrains later website links or external browser navigation.
recommendedRetainedAnswers.limitation: Do not describe the browser as a domain-locked WebView. Reassess if an arbitrary URL/search feature, user-supplied URL or general-purpose browser is added.

recommendedRetainedAnswers.basis: The new listing-only Paranormal History Walking Ghost Tour card has a neutral title, generic comparison summary and booking checks. No frightening stories, imagery, audio or presentation are in the inspected native metadata. Apple defines a fear-evoking criterion; a supernatural keyword alone does not establish it.
recommendedRetainedAnswers.limitation: The actual current provider tour description was not established by the web tool; its category/cached result does not prove either frightening content or its absence. Reassess if the app presents ghost stories, frightening imagery or comparable fear-evoking content.

recommendedRetainedAnswers.basis: Retain the original bear-spray safety-reference answer. New mapped product/group metadata contains no verified firearm or weapons content requiring higher intensity. Technical equipment and ordinary adventure eligibility wording do not establish violent content.

contentClassificationLimits.medicalFrequencyRationale: A small ancillary subset of a general travel directory offers non-graphic safety-management information. Not a medical app or treatment-focused catalogue.
contentClassificationLimits.reasonNoRatingPrediction: Apple generates OS- and region-specific ratings from the full saved questionnaire. No changed questionnaire or resulting rating was saved/read back by this audit.

privacyDelta.recommendation: No newly evidenced data type, purpose or ATT requirement from the expanded fixed directory; retain the separately evidenced operational-log labels pending contrary actual data-flow evidence.

staticReferences.GetYourGuide: Existing partner_id plus the same cmp=banffboundapp for every visitor.
staticReferences.Vrbo: Existing fixed affiliate wrapper and editorial property destination.
staticReferences.BanffBound: Curated owned-guide routes without user trip or personal query parameters.

browserFlow.ios: Explicit WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync -> SFSafariViewController in installed expo-web-browser 57.0.3; no custom WKWebView, injected script or bridge.
browserFlow.android: Explicit Custom Tabs-capable browser package, fail/retry if unavailable; no universal-link fallback.
browserFlow.noAttributionGuarantee: A browser referral and fixed campaign parameter do not prove consent, attribution, a completed booking or commission.

separateConcepts: The age Advertising capability describes content/promotion. It does not by itself establish collection of Advertising Data, a privacy advertising purpose, or ATT tracking.
Showing wellness/medical content is not collection of the user health or fitness data.
Existing map/weather retained-request labels remain; this is not a No Data Collected finding.
privacyDelta.applePolicyQualification: SFSafariViewController alone is not a blanket privacy exemption. Apple requires controlled web-feature collection/tracking to be considered and distinguishes open-web navigation. The conclusion here rests on explicit browser launches with no app-specific personal-data transfer, SDK, session bridge or click endpoint, not solely the API name.
privacyDelta.providerBoundary: Providers may retain ordinary requests and use browser cookies under their own terms. This audit does not certify provider retention, all later website scripts, or web-to-web cookie attribution practices.

sourceDeltaFromPrior706.scope: Only source pin, generator, generated directory and inventory differ among the 12 audited source hashes. Existing App, component, URL guard, browser dependency/config and privacy copy hashes match the prior 706-entry audit.

necessaryBeforeRepresentingExpandedBuild: Refresh the three recommended answers against this 1,205-entry source snapshot; retain other reviewed settings unless actual new content establishes a change.
Save and independently read back the full questionnaire and Apple-generated regional/OS ratings.
Bind the receipt to the actual selected expanded native build; do not use an old bundled-guide receipt as its classification evidence.
releaseReadiness.existingReviewScope: This is evidence for the forthcoming 1,205-entry expanded directory build only; it is not an instruction to alter the already submitted earlier binary.

evidence.appPresentation: Title and planning summary, then explicit full-guide browser link. Full article is not bundled offline.
evidence.observedContent: The live article lists possible altitude-illness symptoms, advises stopping ascent while unwell and seeking assisted descent/medical help for worsening illness, and identifies emergency signs. It expressly avoids individual risk scoring, diagnosis, prescribing and dosing.

evidence.appPresentation: Guide-index title and summary with explicit browser CTA.
evidence.observedContent: The resolved published article covers classes and retreats, recommends bringing a mat for self-directed outdoor yoga, and gives general practice preparation advice. This supplies lifestyle/exercise recommendations. Topic review does not verify every venue, price or programme claim.

Current resolved pages primarily compare spa/pool/heritage access and require published class/retreat programmes. Amenity references alone are not a diagnosis or treatment claim. Yoga self-care recommendations elsewhere independently establish the health/wellness answer.

Native metadata explicitly describes hypothermia signs and trail emergency response. This is additional limited safety context; the altitude live article is the primary medical-management evidence. No contact numbers or personal details are reproduced in this audit.

Provider-labelled commissioned tours/stays/referrals with adjacent commission notices; 667 affiliate CTAs. Search/filter/detail remain local; no remote provider image/widget/prefetch or click-event endpoint.
